description: This file is a comprehensive Python script for a video processing pipeline that uses YOLO object detection (specifically for bears), integrates with AWS S3 for input and output storage, and optionally connects to a MySQL database for storing detection records. It includes environment variable loading, S3 interactions, database setup, video frame sampling, object detection, annotation, and data export functionalities.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Dataclass holding all configuration parameters loaded from environment variables for database and AWS credentials.

methods.name: Config load_env_from_local()
methods.description: Loads environment variables from a .env file located in the script's directory, with fallbacks to environment variables.

methods.name: Tuple[str,str] parse_s3_uri(uri: str)
methods.description: Parses an s3:// URI into bucket and key components, allowing spaces in key.

methods.name: make_s3_client(cfg: Config)
methods.description: Creates a boto3 S3 client using credentials from configuration.

methods.name: str download_s3_to_temp(s3_client, bucket: str, key: str)
methods.description: Downloads an S3 object to a temporary local file, returning the path.

methods.name: str upload_file_to_s3(s3_client, local_path: str, bucket: str, key: str, region: str)
methods.description: Uploads a local file to S3 and returns its virtual-hosted URL.

methods.name: init_db(cfg: Config)
methods.description: Initializes the MySQL database connection, creates database and table if they do not exist.

methods.name: insert_detection_row(conn, row: dict)
methods.description: Inserts a detection record into the database.

methods.name: ensure_csv_with_headers(csv_path: Path)
methods.description: Creates the CSV file with headers if it does not exist.

methods.name: append_csv_row(csv_path: Path, row: dict)
methods.description: Appends a detection record as a row in the CSV file.

methods.name: str build_output_key(prefix: Optional[str], filename: str)
methods.description: Constructs the S3 key for output files using the optional prefix.

methods.name: draw_annotations(frame, boxes, class_names, confidences, color=(0, 255, 0))
methods.description: Draws bounding boxes and labels on image frames.

methods.name: int get_frame_interval(cap)
methods.description: Calculates the frame interval to sample frames approximately every 4 seconds.

methods.name: Iterator[Tuple[int,float,any]] iter_sampled_frames(cap)
methods.description: Generator yielding sampled frames based on calculated interval.

methods.name: Tuple[List[Tuple[float,float,float,float]],List[str],List[float],List[int]] filter_bear_detections(result)
methods.description: Filters detection results for the 'bear' class or returns all detections with class info.

methods.name: run_pipeline( input_path_or_s3: str, model_path: str, output_bucket: str, output_prefix: Optional[str], csv_file: Path, min_conf: float, )
methods.description: Main function that executes the processing pipeline: loading video, detection, annotation, upload, and database recording.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: CLI entry point to run the pipeline with command line arguments.

methods.name: Optional[str] getv(key: str, default: Optional[str] = None)

ctags.name: download_s3_to_temp
ctags.pattern: /^def download_s3_to_temp(s3_client, bucket: str, key: str) -> str:$/

ctags.name: filter_bear_detections
ctags.pattern: /^def filter_bear_detections(result) -> Tuple[List[Tuple[float, float, float, float]], List[str], /

ctags.name: getv
ctags.pattern: /^    def getv(key: str, default: Optional[str] = None) -> Optional[str]:$/

ctags.name: run_pipeline
ctags.signature: ( input_path_or_s3: str, model_path: str, output_bucket: str, output_prefix: Optional[str], csv_file: Path, min_conf: float, )

ctags.name: upload_file_to_s3
ctags.pattern: /^def upload_file_to_s3(s3_client, local_path: str, bucket: str, key: str, region: str) -> str:$/
ctags.signature: (s3_client, local_path: str, bucket: str, key: str, region: str)
